text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Gone in a flash. I can hardly believe
summer camp
is over already.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: The Mainichi Okan is just a month away.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Which means! We can finally SETTLE
THE
SCOOORE!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, El. I see you're as energetic as ever
today.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: And you're as tranquila as ever!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
But... Heh heh! I know ya reached a new
level this
summer!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That's what I love to see! That's why
we've gotta
do this!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You got that?
I'll be waitin' for ya at the
Mainichi
Okan!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Um, I hate to put a damper on your
dramatic exit,
but...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I see you every day. We're going back
home to the same exact dorm room, and
we'll be sitting
next to each other for
the whole bus ride there.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
C'mon! Por favor! You're supposed to
play along!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, my summer camp with Grass
Wonder
comes to a close!
